svg.title: School records before the event
svg.desc: School records before the event; 2016 comparison schools: 98.0 %; 2016 schools that later lost provision: 96.1 %; 2017 comparison schools: 98.1 %; 2017 schools that later lost provision: 97.0 %; 2018 comparison schools: 98.1 %; 2018 schools that later lost provision: 97.4 %; 2019 comparison schools: 98.1 %; 2019 schools that later lost provision: 94.2 %; 2020 comparison schools: 98.1 %; 2020 schools that later lost provision: 97.0 %; 2021 comparison schools: withheld to prevent small-group disclosure when tables are combined; 2021 schools that later lost provision: 95.1 %; 2022 comparison schools: 98.5 %; 2022 schools that later lost provision: suppressed: few schools; 2023 comparison schools: 98.1 %; 2023 schools that later lost provision: 97.4 %; 2024 comparison schools: 97.5 %; 2024 schools that later lost provision: 94.6 %. Students in school cohorts eligible for progression or grade-lag analysis; event cohorts 2016–2024 (modern definition). Observed rate of any school record between the second and first years before the event (G−2 to G−1), for schools that later lost provision and comparison schools; 0–100% scale. The student set differs from the primary analysis, which starts at G−1. Each rate pair describes different arms, not an individual trajectory. There is no adjustment, uncertainty interval, or test of anticipation or parallel trends. Unavailable rates are privacy suppressed. Some rates are withheld to prevent small-group disclosure when the two outcome tables are combined. The CSV retains every cohort and arm, disclosable student/school denominators and absence reasons; no identifiers or quantiles.
